bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀
title.en: Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1
title.raw: 卷四十五 唐書21: 閔帝本紀 Volume 45 Book of Later Tang 21: Emperor Min Annals 1

sentences.zh: 閔帝，諱從厚，小字菩薩奴，明宗第三子也。

translations.literal: Emperor Min, taboo name Conghou, childhood name Bodhisattva Slave, was Mingzong's third son.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Min, born Li Conghou, childhood name Bodhisattva Slave, was Mingzong's third son.

sentences.zh: 母昭懿皇后夏氏，以天祐十一年歲在甲戌，十一月二十八日庚申，生帝於晉陽舊第。

translations.literal: His mother was Empress Zhaoyi Lady Xia; in the eleventh year of Tianyou, year jiaxu, on the twenty-eighth day of the eleventh month, gengshen, the Emperor was born at the old residence in Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Empress Zhaoyi Lady Xia; he was born on gengshen, the twenty-eighth of the eleventh month in Tianyou 11 (934) at the old Jinyang residence.

sentences.zh: 帝髫齔好讀《春秋》，略通大義，貌類明宗，尤鍾愛。

translations.literal: In childhood he loved reading the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 and grasped its broad meaning; his appearance resembled Mingzong's, and he was especially cherished.
translations.idiomatic: As a boy he loved the Spring and Autumn Annals and grasped its meaning; he looked like Mingzong and was especially favored.

sentences.zh: 四年十一月二十日，秦王誅。

translations.literal: On the twentieth day of the eleventh month of the fourth year the Prince of Qin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On the twentieth of the eleventh month in the fourth year Prince of Qin Congrong was killed.

sentences.zh: 翌日，明宗遣宣徽使孟漢瓊馳驛召帝，二十六日，明宗崩，二十九日，帝至自鄴。

translations.literal: The next day Mingzong sent Palace Gate Commissioner Meng Hanqiong by express relay to summon the Emperor; on the twenty-sixth Mingzong died; on the twenty-ninth the Emperor arrived from Ye.
translations.idiomatic: The next day Mingzong sent Meng Hanqiong by express to summon him; Mingzong died on the twenty-sixth; Conghou arrived from Yedu on the twenty-ninth.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸卯朔，發喪於西宮，帝於柩前即位。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, guimao new moon: mourning was proclaimed at the Western Palace; the Emperor assumed the throne before the coffin.
translations.idiomatic: On the guimao new moon in the twelfth month mourning began at the Western Palace and Conghou took the throne before the coffin.

sentences.zh: 丁未，群臣上表請聽政，表再上，詔允。

translations.literal: On dingwei the hundred officials submitted memorials requesting that he hear government; the memorial was submitted again; an edict approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei officials twice asked him to take up government; he approved.

sentences.zh: 己酉，中外將士給賜有差。

translations.literal: On jiyou inside and outside, generals and soldiers received differentiated grants.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou civil and military forces received graded rewards.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，帝縗服見群臣於廣壽門之東廡下，宰臣馮道進曰：「陛下久居哀毀，臣等鹹願一睹聖顏。

translations.literal: On gengxu the Emperor in mourning garments saw the hundred officials under the eastern corridor of the Broad Longevity Gate; Chancellor Feng Dao advanced and said: "Your Majesty has long dwelt in grief and emaciation; your servants all wish to glimpse the sacred countenance.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu the emperor, still in mourning, met officials in the east corridor of Broad Longevity Gate; Feng Dao said, "Your Majesty has mourned so long—we wish to see your face.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭前舉帽，群臣再拜而退。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao stepped forward and raised the hat; the hundred officials bowed again and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao lifted his mourning cap; officials bowed and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 禦光政樓存問軍民。

translations.literal: He took the Bright Government Tower to inquire after soldiers and civilians.
translations.idiomatic: He appeared at Bright Government Tower to address troops and people.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，賜司衣王氏死，坐秦王事也。

translations.literal: On xinhai Palace Wardrobe Lady Wang was granted death for involvement in Prince of Qin affairs.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Lady Wang of the wardrobe service was executed for ties to Prince of Qin Congrong.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏權知河南府事，尋以盧質代之。

translations.literal: On guichou former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was made acting Henan prefecture regent; soon Lu Zhi replaced him.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou former Zhen commissioner Prince of Jing Congmin acted as Henan regent, soon replaced by Lu Zhi.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，賜司儀康氏死，事連王氏也。

translations.literal: On yimao Palace Ceremonial Lady Kang was granted death, the affair connected with Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Lady Kang of ceremonial service was executed in connection with Lady Wang.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，以天雄軍節度判官唐汭為諫議大夫，掌書記趙彖為起居郎，元從都押衙宋令詢為磁州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingchen Tianxiong Army military commissioner adjutant Tang Rui was made Reminder; secretary Zhao Yan was made Court Diarist; original follower chief escort Song Lingxun was made Cizhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Tang Rui, Tianxiong adjutant, became reminder; Zhao Yan secretary became court diarist; Song Lingxun became Cizhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以左僕射、平章事馮道為山陵使，戶部尚書韓彥惲為副，中書舍人王延為判官，禮部尚書王權為禮儀使，兵部尚書李鈴為鹵簿使，御史中丞龍敏為儀仗使，右僕射、權知河南府盧質為橋道頓遞使。

translations.literal: On dingsi Left Vice Director and Associate Counsellor Feng Dao was made mountain-tomb commissioner; Minister of Revenue Han Yanhun deputy; Secretariat Drafter Wang Yan adjutant; Minister of Rites Wang Quan ritual commissioner; Minister of War Li Ling guard-of-honor commissioner; Censor-in-Chief Long Min ceremonial-arm commissioner; Right Vice Director and acting Henan regent Lu Zhi bridge-road relay commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi Feng Dao led the tomb commission with Han Yanhun as deputy, Wang Yan adjutant, Wang Quan for rites, Li Ling for guards, Long Min for ceremonial arms, and Lu Zhi for relay roads.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以前相州刺史郝瓊為右驍衛大將軍，充宣徽北院使；

translations.literal: On gengshen former Xiangzhou prefect Hao Qiong was made Right Martial Steed grand general, filling Northern Court of the Palace Directorate commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Hao Qiong, former Xiang prefect, became right martial steed grand general and northern palace directorate commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以光祿卿、充三司副使王玫為三司使。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting Three Departments deputy commissioner Wang Mei was made Three Departments commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Mei, grand master of splendid happiness and acting Three Departments deputy, became Three Departments commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，故檢校太尉、右衛上將軍、充三司使孫嶽贈太尉、齊國公。

translations.literal: On guihai the late Acting Grand Mentor, Right Guard senior general, and Three Departments commissioner Sun Yue was posthumously granted Grand Mentor and Duke of Qi state.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the late Sun Yue, acting grand mentor and Three Departments commissioner, was posthumously made grand mentor and Duke of Qi.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，帝釋縗服，群臣三上表，請復常膳，禦正殿，從之。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Emperor doffed mourning garments; the hundred officials three times submitted memorials requesting restoration of regular meals and taking the main hall; it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he left mourning dress; officials three times asked him to resume normal meals and hold court in the main hall; he agreed.

sentences.zh: 辛未，帝御中興殿，群臣列位，馮道升階進酒。

translations.literal: On xinwei the Emperor took the Hall of Revival; the hundred officials took their places; Feng Dao ascended the steps and presented wine.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei he held court at the Hall of Revival; Feng Dao ascended and offered wine.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「比於此物無愛，除賓友之會，不近樽斝。

translations.literal: The Emperor said: "Compared with this thing I have no fondness; apart from gatherings with guests and friends I do not approach cups and goblets.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said, "I care little for wine except among friends.

sentences.zh: 況在沉痛之中，安事飲啖！

translations.literal: How much less in deep grief—what affair is there for eating and drinking!
translations.idiomatic: How much less now, in deepest mourning—why drink?

sentences.zh: 」命徹之。

translations.literal: He ordered it removed.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the wine taken away.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，宰臣馮道加司空，李愚加右僕射，劉煦加吏部尚書，餘並如故。

translations.literal: On gengchen Chancellor Feng Dao was advanced to Director of Works; Li Yu to Right Vice Director; Liu Xu to Minister of Personnel; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Feng Dao became director of works; Li Yu right vice director; Liu Xu personnel minister; others unchanged.

sentences.zh: 壬午，侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、河陽節度使康義誠加檢校太尉、兼侍中，判六軍諸衛事。

translations.literal: On renwu Personal Guard Army horse-and-foot commander-in-chief and Hedong military commissioner Kang Yicheng was advanced to Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant, judging the Six Armies and various guards.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu Kang Yicheng, personal guard commander and Hedong commissioner, became acting grand mentor and palace attendant overseeing the Six Armies and guards.

sentences.zh: 甲申，以侍衛馬軍都指揮使、寧國軍節度使安彥威為河中節度使；

translations.literal: On jiashen Palace Guard horse army commander-in-chief and Ningguo Army military commissioner An Yanwei was made Hezhong military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen An Yanwei, guard horse commander and Ningguo commissioner, became Hezhong commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以侍衛步軍都指揮使、忠正軍節度使張從賓為涇州節度使，並加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: Palace Guard foot army commander-in-chief and Zhongzheng Army military commissioner Zhang Congbin was made Jingzhou military commissioner, both advanced to Acting Grand Tutor;
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Congbin, guard foot commander and Zhongzheng commissioner, became Jing commissioner, both made acting grand tutor;

sentences.zh: 以捧聖左右廂都指揮使、欽州刺史朱洪實為寧國軍節度使，加檢校太保，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使；

translations.literal: Upholding Sage left and right wing commander-in-chief and Qinzhou prefect Zhu Hongshi was made Ningguo Army military commissioner, advanced to Acting Grand Guardian, filling Palace Guard horse army commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongshi, Upholding Sage wing commander and Qin prefect, became Ningguo commissioner, acting grand guardian, and guard horse commander;

sentences.zh: 以嚴衛左右廂都指揮使、岩州刺史皇甫遇為忠正軍節度使、檢校太保，充侍衛步軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: Stern Guard left and right wing commander-in-chief and Yanzhou prefect Huangfu Yu was made Zhongzheng Army military commissioner, Acting Grand Guardian, filling Palace Guard foot army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Huangfu Yu, Stern Guard wing commander and Yan prefect, became Zhongzheng commissioner, acting grand guardian, and guard foot commander.

sentences.zh: 戊子，樞密使、檢校太尉、同平章事朱宏昭，樞密使、檢校太尉、同中書門下二品馮贇並加兼中書令。

translations.literal: On wuzi Commissioner of Military Affairs, Acting Grand Mentor and Associate Counsellor Zhu Hongzhao, and Commissioner of Military Affairs, Acting Grand Mentor and Second Rank of the Secretariat and Chancellery Feng Yun were both advanced to concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun, military affairs commissioners and acting grand mentors, were also made secretariat directors.

sentences.zh: 北京留守、河東節度使兼大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管石敬瑭加兼中書令；

translations.literal: Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner and concurrent Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies foreign and Han horse-and-foot commander-in-chief Shi Jingtang was advanced to concurrent Director of the Secretariat;
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang of Beijing and Hedong, also commander of northern armies, was made secretariat director;

sentences.zh: 幽州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令趙德鈞加檢校太師、兼中書令。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Zhao Dejun was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Dejun of Youzhou, acting grand mentor and secretariat director, became acting grand tutor and secretariat director.

sentences.zh: 樞密使馮贇表堅讓中書令，製改兼侍中，封邠國公。

translations.literal: Commissioner of Military Affairs Feng Yun memorialized firmly declining Director of the Secretariat; an edict changed it to concurrent Palace Attendant and enfeoffed Duke of Bin state.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Yun firmly declined secretariat director; the edict made him palace attendant instead and enfeoffed him Duke of Bin.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂加兼侍中；

translations.literal: On gengyin Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was advanced to concurrent Palace Attendant;
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin Prince of Lu Congke of Fengxiang was also made palace attendant;

sentences.zh: 青州節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令房知溫加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Qingzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Fang Zhiwen was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Fang Zhiwen of Qing, acting grand mentor and secretariat director, became acting grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以翰林學士承旨、尚書右丞李懌為工部尚書，以秘書監盧文紀為太常卿，充山陵禮儀使。

translations.literal: On xinmao Hanlin Academician Expositor and Master of the Works Right Assistant Li Yi was made Minister of Works; Director of the Palace Library Lu Wenji was made Grand Minister of Ceremonies, filling mountain-tomb ritual commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Yi, hanlin expositor and right assistant minister of works, became works minister; Lu Wenji, palace librarian, became grand minister of ceremonies for the tomb rites.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，荊南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令高從誨封南平王；

translations.literal: On renchen Jingnan military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Gao Conghui was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Gao Conghui of Jingnan was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;

sentences.zh: 湖南節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令馬希範封楚王。

translations.literal: Hunan military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat Ma Xifan was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xifan of Hunan was enfeoffed Prince of Chu.

sentences.zh: 甲午，兩浙節度使、檢校太師、守中書令、吳王錢元瓘進封吳越王；

translations.literal: On jiawu the two Zhe military commissioner, Acting Grand Tutor, acting Director of the Secretariat, and Prince of Wu Qian Yuanguan was advanced to Prince of Wuyue;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Qian Yuanguan of the two Zhe, acting grand tutor and Prince of Wu, became Prince of Wuyue;

sentences.zh: 前洺州團練使皇甫立加檢校太保，充鄜州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Luozhou training commissioner Huangfu Li was advanced to Acting Grand Guardian, filling Yanzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: former Luozhou training commissioner Huangfu Li became acting grand guardian and Yan commissioner;

sentences.zh: 前彰義軍節度使康福加檢校太傅，充邠州節度使；

translations.literal: Former Zhangyi Army military commissioner Kang Fu was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor, filling Binzhou military commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: Kang Fu, former Zhangyi commissioner, became acting grand tutor and Bin commissioner;

sentences.zh: 劍南東、西兩川節度使、檢校太尉、兼中書令、蜀王孟知祥加檢校太師。

translations.literal: Eastern and western Jiannan military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, Prince of Shu Meng Zhixiang was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang of both Jiannan circuits, Prince of Shu, became acting grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 製下，知祥辭不受命。

translations.literal: When the edict was issued, Zhixiang declined and did not accept the appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Zhixiang declined the appointment.

sentences.zh: 丙申，鎮州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中範延光，汴州節度使、檢校太尉、兼侍中趙延壽，並加檢校太師。

translations.literal: On bingshen Zhenzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant Fan Yanguang and Bianzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Palace Attendant Zhao Yanshou were both advanced to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen Fan Yanguang of Zhen and Zhao Yanshou of Bian, both acting grand mentors, became acting grand tutors.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，山南西道節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事張虔釗，襄州節度使趙在禮，並加檢校太尉。

translations.literal: On wuxu southern Shannan western-circuit military commissioner, Acting Grand Tutor and Associate Counsellor Zhang Qianzhao and Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhao Zaili were both advanced to Acting Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu Zhang Qianzhao of southern Shannan west and Zhao Zaili of Xiang became acting grand mentors.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，以振武軍節度使、安北都護楊檀兼大同、彰國、振武、威塞等軍都虞候，充北面馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: On xinchou Zhenwu Army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Yang Tan was made concurrent Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies chief adjutant, filling northern horse army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou Yang Tan of Zhenwu, also protector-general of pacifying the north, became northern armies chief adjutant and horse army commander.

sentences.zh: 閏月壬寅朔，群臣赴西宮臨。

translations.literal: Intercalary month, renyin new moon: the hundred officials went to the Western Palace for mourning attendance.
translations.idiomatic: On the renyin new moon in the intercalary month officials attended mourning at the Western Palace.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，禦文明殿入閣。

translations.literal: On guimao he took the Hall of Civilization for entering the side hall.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao he entered the side hall at the Hall of Civilization.

sentences.zh: 以前右僕射、權知河南府事盧質為太子少傅兼河南尹。

translations.literal: Former Right Vice Director and acting Henan regent Lu Zhi was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent and concurrent Henan Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Zhi, former right vice director and acting Henan regent, became junior heir-apparent tutor and Henan intendant.

sentences.zh: 以諫議大夫唐汭、膳部郎中知制誥陳乂並為給事中，充樞密院直學士。

translations.literal: Reminder Tang Rui and Board of Rites bureau director and drafting edicts Chen Yi were both made Drafting Attendant, filling Military Affairs Commission direct academicians.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Rui, reminder, and Chen Yi, rituals director drafting edicts, became drafting attendants and military affairs direct academicians.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Bracket note

sentences.zh: （《通鑒》：汭以文學從帝，曆三鎮在幕府。

translations.literal: (The 《Comprehensive Mirror》: Rui followed the Emperor for his literary talent through three military commissioners' staffs.
translations.idiomatic: (From the Comprehensive Mirror: Tang Rui had followed the emperor for his literary talent through three commissioners' staffs.

sentences.zh: 及即位，將佐之有才者，朱、馮皆斥逐之。

translations.literal: When he took the throne, talented aides were all dismissed by Zhu and Feng.
translations.idiomatic: On his accession Zhu and Feng dismissed talented aides.

sentences.zh: 汭性迂疏，朱、馮恐帝含怒有時而發，乃引汭於密近，以其黨陳乂監之。）〉

translations.literal: Rui was blunt and distant; Zhu and Feng feared the Emperor would harbor anger and release it in time, and so drew Rui into close secrecy, with their partisan Chen Yi supervising him.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Rui was blunt; fearing the emperor's anger, Zhu and Feng kept him close with their ally Chen Yi watching him.)〉

sentences.zh: 宣徽南院使、驃騎大將軍、左衛上將軍、知內侍省孟漢瓊加開府儀同三司，賜忠貞扶運保泰功臣。

translations.literal: Southern Court of the Palace Directorate commissioner, Rapid-as-Lightning Grand General, Left Guard senior general, and acting Director of the Palace Service Meng Hanqiong was advanced to Grand Preceptor of the Palace with Equivalence to the Three Excellencies and granted the merit title Loyal, Chaste, Supporting Fortune, Preserving Peace, and Protecting Tai.
translations.idiomatic: Meng Hanqiong, southern palace directorate commissioner, was made grand preceptor with three-excellency equivalence and granted the merit title Loyal, Chaste, Supporting Fortune, Preserving Peace, and Protecting Tai.

sentences.zh: 丙午，正衙命使冊皇太后曹氏。

translations.literal: On bingwu in the main court audience messengers were commissioned to enfeoff the Empress Dowager Lady Cao.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu messengers in formal court enfeoffed Empress Dowager Lady Cao.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以前雄武軍節度使劉仲殷為右衛上將軍，邢州節度使趙鳳加爵邑。

translations.literal: On wushen former Xiongwu Army military commissioner Liu Zhongyin was made Right Guard senior general; Xingzhou military commissioner Zhao Feng received increased fief.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Liu Zhongyin, former Xiong commissioner, became right guard senior general; Zhao Feng of Xing received added fief.

sentences.zh: 自是諸藩鎮文武臣僚皆次第加恩，帝嗣位覃恩澤也。

translations.literal: From this the various military commissioners' civil and military officials were all advanced in favor in turn—the Emperor's succession-wide grace.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter frontier officials received succession favors in turn.

sentences.zh: 以翰林學士、中書舍人崔棁為工部侍郎，依前充職。

translations.literal: Hanlin Academician and Secretariat Drafter Cui Dong was made Vice Minister of Works, continuing in office as before.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Dong, hanlin academician and secretariat drafter, became vice works minister while keeping his post.

sentences.zh: 以給事中張鵬為御史中丞，以御史中丞龍敏為兵部侍郎，以太僕少卿竇維為大理卿。

translations.literal: Drafting Attendant Zhang Peng was made Censor-in-Chief; Censor-in-Chief Long Min Vice Minister of War; Grand Master of the Imperial Stud Vice Minister Dou Wei Grand Court Judge.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Peng became censor-in-chief; Long Min vice war minister; Dou Wei grand court judge.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，正衙命使冊皇太妃王氏。

translations.literal: On jiayin in the main court audience messengers were commissioned to enfeoff the Grand Imperial Consort Lady Wang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin messengers enfeoffed Grand Imperial Consort Lady Wang.

sentences.zh: 集賢院上言：「準敕書修創淩煙閣，尋奉詔問閣高下等級。

translations.literal: The Hall of Assembled Worthies memorialized: "Per the edict to repair and renew the Lingyan Pavilion, we then received an edict inquiring about the pavilion's height and grade.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Assembled Worthies reported that under orders to rebuild Lingyan Pavilion they had been asked about its height and layout.

sentences.zh: 謹按淩煙閣，都長安時在西內三清殿側，畫像皆北面，閣有中隔，隔內面北寫功高宰輔，南面寫功高諸侯王，隔外面次第圖畫功臣題讚。

translations.literal: We respectfully find that the Lingyan Pavilion, in Chang'an times, was beside the Three Pure Ones Hall in the western inner palace; the portraits all faced north; the pavilion had a central partition; within the partition, facing north were painted high-merit chancellors, facing south high-merit princes and kings; outside the partition in sequence were painted meritorious officials with inscriptions.
translations.idiomatic: The original Lingyan Pavilion in Chang'an stood beside the Three Pure Ones Hall; portraits faced north with a central partition—chancellors north, princes south, meritorious officials outside with inscriptions.

sentences.zh: 自西京板蕩，四十餘年，舊日主掌官吏及畫像工人，並已淪喪，集賢院所管寫真官、畫真官人數不少，都洛後廢職。

translations.literal: Since the western capital's turmoil, more than forty years have passed; former managing officials and portrait painters have all perished; the portrait officials and painting officials under the Hall of Assembled Worthies are not few, but after settling Luoyang the posts were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: After forty years since the capital's fall, old officials and painters were gone; portrait posts at the Hall of Assembled Worthies had been abolished after the move to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 今將起閣，望先定佐命功臣人數，請下翰林院預令寫真本，及下將作監興功，次序間架修建。

translations.literal: Now in raising the pavilion we hope first to fix the number of founding ministers, request the Hanlin Academy to prepare portrait drafts in advance, and the Directorate of Works to undertake construction in proper sequence and framing.
translations.idiomatic: They asked to fix the number of founding ministers, have the Hanlin prepare portrait drafts, and the Directorate of Works rebuild in proper order.

sentences.zh: 」乃詔集賢御書院復置寫真官、畫真官各一員，餘依所奏。

translations.literal: An edict then ordered the Hall of Assembled Worthies Imperial Calligraphy Academy to restore one portrait official and one painting official each; the rest as memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: An edict restored one portrait official and one painting official at the imperial calligraphy academy; the rest as proposed.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，安州奏，此月七日夜，節度使符彥超為部曲王希全所害，廢朝一日。

translations.literal: On dingsi Anzhou memorialized that on the seventh night of this month military commissioner Fu Yanchao was killed by his troops under Wang Xiquan; court audience was suspended one day.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi An reported that on the seventh Fu Yanchao was killed by his officer Wang Xiquan; court was suspended one day.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前振武軍節度使、安北都護高行周為彰武節度使。

translations.literal: On wuwu former Zhenwu Army military commissioner and Protector-General of Pacifying the North Gao Xingzhou was made Zhangwu military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Gao Xingzhou, former Zhenwu commissioner, became Zhangwu commissioner.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以前鄆州使範政為少府監。

translations.literal: On xinyou former Yanzhou envoy Fan Zheng was made Vice Director of the Palace Workshops.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Fan Zheng, former Yan envoy, became vice director of palace workshops.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，幸至德宮。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin the emperor visited the Palace of Supreme Virtue.

sentences.zh: 車駕至興教門，有飛鳶自空而墜，僵於御前。

translations.literal: When the imperial carriage reached the Gate of Promoting Instruction, a kite fell from the sky and lay stiff before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: At the Gate of Promoting Instruction a kite fell dead before the carriage.

sentences.zh: 是日大風晦冥。

translations.literal: That day great wind and dark gloom.
translations.idiomatic: That day brought fierce wind and murky skies.

sentences.zh: 二月乙亥，以前鎮州節度使、涇王從敏為宋州節度使。

translations.literal: Second month, yihai: former Zhenzhou military commissioner, Prince of Jing Congmin was made Songzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the second month Prince of Jing Congmin, former Zhen commissioner, became Song commissioner.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以前徐州節度使、檢校太傅李敬周為安州節度使。

translations.literal: On jimao former Xuzhou military commissioner, Acting Grand Tutor Li Jingzhou was made Anzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Jingzhou, former Xu commissioner and acting grand tutor, became An commissioner.

sentences.zh: 是日，宣授鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂為權北京留守；

translations.literal: That day by imperial announcement Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke was made acting Beijing regent;
translations.idiomatic: That day Prince of Lu Congke of Fengxiang was named acting Beijing regent;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守石敬瑭權知鎮州軍州事；

translations.literal: Beijing regent Shi Jingtang was made acting Zhenzhou military and civil regent;
translations.idiomatic: Beijing regent Shi Jingtang acted as Zhen regent;

sentences.zh: 以鎮州範延光權知鄴都留守事；

translations.literal: Zhenzhou Fan Yanguang was made acting Yedu regent;
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yanguang of Zhen acted as Yedu regent;

sentences.zh: 以前河中節度使、洋王從璋權知鳳翔軍軍府事。

translations.literal: former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was made acting Fengxiang army headquarters regent.
translations.idiomatic: former Yang prince Congzhang of Hezhong acted as Fengxiang regent.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，幸山陵工作所。

translations.literal: On gengyin the Emperor visited the mountain-tomb construction site.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin he visited the tomb construction site.

sentences.zh: 是日，西京留守王思同奏，鳳翔節度使、潞王從珂拒命。

translations.literal: That day western capital regent Wang Sitong memorialized that Fengxiang military commissioner, Prince of Lu Congke had defied orders.
translations.idiomatic: That day Wang Sitong of the western capital reported Prince of Lu Congke had defied orders.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，王思同加同平章事，充西面行營都部署；

translations.literal: On dingyou Wang Sitong was made Associate Counsellor, filling western campaign commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Wang Sitong became associate counsellor and western campaign commander;

sentences.zh: 以前邠州節度使藥彥稠為副部署。

translations.literal: former Binzhou military commissioner Yao Yanchou was made deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: former Bin commissioner Yao Yanchou was his deputy.

sentences.zh: 以河中節度使安彥威為西面兵馬都監，以前定州節度使李德充為權北京留守。

translations.literal: Hezhong military commissioner An Yanwei was made western campaign horse-and-foot inspector; former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made acting Beijing regent.
translations.idiomatic: An Yanwei of Hezhong became western horse-and-foot inspector; Li Dechong, former Ding commissioner, acting Beijing regent.

sentences.zh: 山陵使奏：「伏睹御劄，皇帝親奉靈駕至園陵。

translations.literal: The mountain-tomb commissioner memorialized: "We respectfully behold the imperial rescript that the Emperor will personally escort the spirit carriage to the imperial park tomb.
translations.idiomatic: The tomb commissioners reported that the emperor planned to escort the coffin personally to Huiling.

sentences.zh: 伏見累朝故事，人君無親送葬之儀，請車駕不行。

translations.literal: We respectfully find in successive dynasties' precedents that sovereigns have no ritual of personally escorting burial; we request the imperial carriage not go.
translations.idiomatic: Precedent showed emperors did not escort burials in person; they asked him not to go.

sentences.zh: 」不從。

translations.literal: Not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: He refused.

sentences.zh: 乙未，樞密使馮贇起復視事，時贇丁母憂也。

translations.literal: On yiwei Commissioner of Military Affairs Feng Yun resumed office while in mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei Feng Yun returned to duty while mourning his mother.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以司農卿張鎛為殿中監。

translations.literal: On jihai Minister of Agriculture Zhang Bo was made Palace Director.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai Zhang Bo, agriculture minister, became palace director.

sentences.zh: 庚子，殿直楚匡祚上言，監取亳州團練使李重吉至宋州，係於軍院。

translations.literal: On gengzi Palace Direct Attendant Chu Kuangzuo memorialized that he had supervised taking Bozhou training commissioner Li Chongji to Songzhou and detained him in the army compound.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi Chu Kuangzuo reported he had escorted Li Chongji, Bozhou training commissioner, to Songzhou and held him in the army compound.

sentences.zh: 重吉，潞王之長子，及幽於宋州，帝猶以金帛賜之，及聞西師鹹叛，方遣使殺之。

translations.literal: Chongji was the Prince of Lu's eldest son; though imprisoned at Songzhou the Emperor still sent gold and silk as gifts; when he heard the western army had all rebelled, he then sent an envoy to kill him.
translations.idiomatic: Chongji was Prince of Lu's eldest son; even imprisoned he received gifts until the western armies rebelled, when the emperor sent men to kill him.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，以前太僕少卿魏仁鍔為太僕卿。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen: former Grand Master of the Imperial Stud Vice Minister Wei Ren'e was made Grand Master of the Imperial Stud.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the third month Wei Ren'e, former vice grand master of the imperial stud, became grand master of the imperial stud.

sentences.zh: 興元節度使張虔釗奏，會合討鳳翔。

translations.literal: Xingyuan military commissioner Zhang Qianzhao memorialized that he had joined forces to attack Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan reported joint operations against Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以右領衛上將軍武延翰為郢州刺史。

translations.literal: On bingwu Right Lead Guard senior general Wu Yanhan was made Ezhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Wu Yanhan, right lead guard senior general, became E prefect.

sentences.zh: 丁未，洋州孫漢韶奏，至興元與張虔釗同議進軍。

translations.literal: On dingwei Yangzhou Sun Hanshao memorialized that he had reached Xingyuan and with Zhang Qianzhao agreed to advance the army.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Sun Hanshao of Yang reported reaching Xingyuan and agreeing with Zhang Qianzhao to advance.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以鎮州節度使範延光依前檢校太師、兼侍中，行興唐尹，充天雄軍節度使、北面水陸轉運製置使；

translations.literal: On jiyou Zhenzhou military commissioner Fan Yanguang, as before Acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant, acted as Xingtang Intendant, filling Tianxiong Army military commissioner and northern land-and-water transport commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Fan Yanguang, acting grand tutor, acted as Xingtang intendant, Tianxiong commissioner, and northern transport commissioner;

sentences.zh: 以北京留守、河東節度使石敬瑭依前檢校太尉、兼中書令，其真定尹、充鎮州節度使、大同彰國振武威塞等軍蕃漢馬步總管如故。

translations.literal: Beijing regent and Hedong military commissioner Shi Jingtang, as before Acting Grand Mentor and concurrent Director of the Secretariat, his Zhending Intendant and Zhenzhou military commissioner and Datong, Zhangguo, Zhenwu, Weisai, and other armies foreign and Han horse-and-foot commander-in-chief as before.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Jingtang kept Hedong, secretariat director, Zhending intendant, Zhen commissioner, and northern army command.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以前定州節度使李德充為北京留守，充河東節度使。

translations.literal: On xinhai former Dingzhou military commissioner Li Dechong was made Beijing regent, filling Hedong military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Li Dechong, former Ding commissioner, became Beijing regent and Hedong commissioner.

sentences.zh: 許王從益加檢校太保，前河中節度使、洋王從璋加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Prince of Xu Congyi was advanced to Acting Grand Guardian; former Hezhong military commissioner, Prince of Yang Congzhang was advanced to Acting Grand Tutor.
translations.idiomatic: Prince of Xu Congyi became acting grand guardian; Prince of Yang Congzhang, former Hezhong commissioner, acting grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 詔：「藩侯帶平章事以上薨，許立神道碑，差官撰文。

translations.literal: An edict: "When military commissioners bearing Associate Counsellor and above die, they may erect spirit-way steles; officials are dispatched to compose the text.
translations.idiomatic: An edict allowed associate counsellors and above who died in frontier posts to erect spirit-way steles with official composers.

sentences.zh: 未帶平章事及刺史，準令式合立碑者，其文任自製撰，不在奏聞。

translations.literal: Those not bearing Associate Counsellor and prefect, who by statute may erect steles, may compose the text themselves, not requiring memorial submission.
translations.idiomatic: Those below associate counsellor without statutory stele rights could write their own texts without memorializing.

sentences.zh: 」乙卯，興元張虔釗奏，自鎮將兵赴鳳翔，收大散關。

translations.literal: On yimao Xingyuan Zhang Qianzhao memorialized that from his post he led troops toward Fengxiang and recovered Dashanguan.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Zhang Qianzhao of Xingyuan reported marching from his post to Fengxiang and recovering Dashanguan.

sentences.zh: 宗正寺奏：「準故事，諸陵有令、丞各一員，近例更委本縣令兼之。

translations.literal: The Court of the Imperial Clan memorialized: "Per precedent, each imperial tomb has one director and one aide; recently the local county magistrate has been made to hold both concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: The imperial clan court noted that tomb directors and aides had lately been doubled with county magistrates.

sentences.zh: 緣河南洛陽是京邑，兼令、丞不便。

translations.literal: Because Henan and Luoyang are the capital territory, concurrent director and aide is inconvenient.
translations.idiomatic: Henan and Luoyang as the capital made that arrangement impractical.

sentences.zh: 」詔特置陵台令、丞各一員。

translations.literal: An edict specially established one tomb-platform director and one aide each.
translations.idiomatic: An edict created separate tomb-platform director and aide posts.

sentences.zh: 己未，以前金吾大將軍李肅為左衛上將軍，充山陵修奉上下宮都部署。

translations.literal: On jiwei former Golden Guard grand general Li Su was made Left Guard senior general, filling upper and lower palace tomb repair and escort commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Li Su, former golden guard grand general, became left guard senior general commanding upper and lower palace tomb repair.

sentences.zh: 庚申，西面步軍都監王景從等自軍前至，奏：「今月十五日，大軍進攻鳳翔。

translations.literal: On gengshen western foot army inspector Wang Jingcong and others arrived from the front and memorialized: "On the fifteenth of this month the great army attacked Fengxiang.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen Wang Jingcong and others from the front reported the main army attacked Fengxiang on the fifteenth.

sentences.zh: 十六日，嚴衛右廂都指揮使尹暉引軍東面入城，右羽林都指揮使楊思權引軍西面入城，山南軍潰。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth Stern Guard right wing commander Yin Hui led troops into the city from the east; Right Forest Guard commander Yang Siquan led troops into the city from the west; the southern Shannan army collapsed.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth Yin Hui's Stern Guard entered from the east and Yang Siquan's Right Forest Guard from the west; the southern Shannan army collapsed.

sentences.zh: 」帝聞之，謂康義誠等曰：「朕幼年嗣位，委政大臣，兄弟之間，必無榛梗。

translations.literal: When the Emperor heard it he said to Kang Yicheng and others: "I succeeded young and entrusted government to great ministers; among brothers surely there is no bramble obstruction.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing this, the emperor told Kang Yicheng and others, "I was young when I succeeded and entrusted power to ministers; there should be no strife among brothers.

sentences.zh: 諸公大計見告，朕獨難違，事至於此，何方轉禍？

translations.literal: You all inform me of the great plan; I alone find it hard to refuse; affairs have reached this—how turn calamity around?
translations.idiomatic: Tell me your plan—I can hardly refuse—but how do we turn this disaster around?

sentences.zh: 朕當與左右自往鳳翔，迎兄主社稷；

translations.literal: I shall go with my close attendants in person to Fengxiang and welcome my elder brother to rule the state;
translations.idiomatic: I will go myself to Fengxiang and welcome my brother to rule;

sentences.zh: 朕自歸藩，於理為便。

translations.literal: I myself return to my fief—in principle that is fitting.
translations.idiomatic: I will return to my princedom—that is only fair.

sentences.zh: 」朱宏昭、馮贇不對，義誠曰：「西師驚潰，蓋由主將失策。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun did not answer; Yicheng said: "The western army's panic and collapse is surely because the commander-in-chief lost his plan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongzhao and Feng Yun were silent; Yicheng said the western army collapsed because its commander blundered.

sentences.zh: 今駕下兵甲尚多，臣請自往關西，振其兵威，扼其衝要。

translations.literal: Now under the imperial carriage arms and armor are still many; your servant requests to go in person to the western passes, rouse their martial prestige, and choke their vital points.
translations.idiomatic: We still have many troops; let me go west, restore morale, and hold the passes.

sentences.zh: 」義誠又累奏請行，帝召侍衛都將以下宣曰：「先皇帝棄萬國，朕於兄弟之中，無心爭立，一旦被召主喪，便委社稷，岐陽兄長，果致猜嫌。

translations.literal: Yicheng again repeatedly memorialized requesting to go; the Emperor summoned the palace guard generals and below and announced: "The Former Emperor abandoned the myriad realms; among my brothers I had no mind to contend for the throne; suddenly summoned to preside over mourning, I then entrusted the state altar; my elder brother of Qiyang indeed brought suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: Yicheng begged repeatedly to go; the emperor told guard generals, "Our father left the realm; I never sought the throne among my brothers; yet my Qiyang brother has turned against me.

sentences.zh: 卿等頃從先朝千征萬戰，今日之事，寧不痛心！

translations.literal: You all followed the Former Court through a thousand campaigns and ten thousand battles—today's affair, can you not be pained at heart!
translations.idiomatic: You fought countless battles for my father—does this not break your hearts!

sentences.zh: 今據府庫，悉以頒賜，卿等勉之！

translations.literal: Now according to the treasury, all is to be distributed—do your utmost!
translations.idiomatic: I am giving you everything in the treasury—do your utmost!

sentences.zh: 」乃出銀絹錢厚賜於諸軍。

translations.literal: Then silver, silk, and cash in generous grants were issued to the various armies.
translations.idiomatic: He then gave the armies lavish silver, silk, and cash.

sentences.zh: 是時方事山陵，復有此賜，府藏為之一空，軍士猶負賞物揚言於路曰：「到鳳翔更請一分。

translations.literal: At the time they were still engaged with the mountain tomb, yet with this grant the treasury was emptied; soldiers still shouldered their rewards and shouted on the road: "At Fengxiang we will ask for another share.
translations.idiomatic: While the tomb work continued this gift emptied the treasury; soldiers still grumbled on the road, "We will demand another share at Fengxiang.

sentences.zh: 」其驕誕無畏如是。

translations.literal: Their arrogance and insolence without fear were thus.
translations.idiomatic: So arrogant and fearless were they.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，幸左藏庫，視給將士金帛。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Emperor visited the Left Treasury to oversee granting gold and silk to generals and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou he visited the Left Treasury to distribute gold and silk to the troops.

sentences.zh: 是日，誅馬軍都指揮使朱洪實，坐與康義誠忿爭故也。

translations.literal: That day horse army commander-in-chief Zhu Hongshi was executed for quarreling with Kang Yicheng.
translations.idiomatic: That day Zhu Hongshi, horse army commander, was executed for quarreling with Kang Yicheng.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以康義誠為鳳翔行營都招討使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On guihai Kang Yicheng was made Fengxiang campaign commander-in-chief, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Kang Yicheng became Fengxiang campaign commander-in-chief; other posts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 以王思同為副招討使；

translations.literal: Wang Sitong was made deputy commander-in-chief;
translations.idiomatic: Wang Sitong became deputy commander;

sentences.zh: 以安從進為順化軍節度使，充侍衛馬軍都指揮使。

translations.literal: An Congjin was made Shunhua Army military commissioner, filling Palace Guard horse army commander-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin became Shunhua commissioner and guard horse commander.

sentences.zh: 詔左右羽林軍四十指揮改為嚴衛，左右龍武、神武軍改為捧聖。

translations.literal: An edict changed the forty commands of left and right Forest Guard armies to Stern Guard, and left and right Martial Valiant and Divine Martial armies to Upholding Sage.
translations.idiomatic: An edict renamed left and right Forest Guard commands to Stern Guard and Martial Valiant and Divine Martial armies to Upholding Sage.

sentences.zh: 甲子，陝州奏，潞王至潼關，害西面都部署王思同。

translations.literal: On jiazi Shanzhou memorialized that the Prince of Lu had reached Tongguan and killed western campaign commander-in-chief Wang Sitong.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Shan reported Prince of Lu Congke reached Tong Pass and killed Wang Sitong.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，宣諭西面行營將士，俟平鳳翔日，人賞二百千，府庫不足，以宮闈服玩增給。

translations.literal: On yihai the western campaign army was announced: when Fengxiang is pacified each man will receive two hundred thousand cash; if the treasury is insufficient, palace wardrobe ornaments will supplement the grant.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai troops were promised two hundred thousand cash each when Fengxiang fell, supplemented from palace goods if needed.

sentences.zh: 詔侍衛馬軍都指揮使安從進京城巡檢。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Palace Guard horse army commander-in-chief An Congjin to patrol the capital.
translations.idiomatic: An edict put An Congjin in charge of capital patrols.

sentences.zh: 是日，從進已得潞王書檄，潛布腹心矣。

translations.literal: That day Congjin had already received the Prince of Lu's proclamation and secretly planted trusted agents.
translations.idiomatic: That day Congjin had already received Congke's proclamation and planted agents.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，潞王至陝州。

translations.literal: On dingmao the Prince of Lu reached Shanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao Prince of Lu Congke reached Shanzhou.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，帝急召孟漢瓊，不至；

translations.literal: On wuchen the Emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong, who did not come;
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen the emperor urgently summoned Meng Hanqiong, who failed to come;

sentences.zh: 召朱宏昭，宏昭懼，投於井。

translations.literal: He summoned Zhu Hongzhao; Hongzhao in fear threw himself into a well.
translations.idiomatic: He summoned Zhu Hongzhao, who in fear jumped into a well.

sentences.zh: 安從進尋殺馮贇於其第。

translations.literal: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his residence.
translations.idiomatic: An Congjin soon killed Feng Yun at his home.

sentences.zh: 是夜，帝以百騎出元武門，謂控鶴指揮使慕容遷曰：「爾誠有馬，控鶴從予。

translations.literal: That night the Emperor with a hundred horsemen went out the Mystic Martial Gate and said to Crane-Control commander Murong Qian: "If you truly have horses, Crane-Control follow me.
translations.idiomatic: That night the emperor rode out Mystic Martial Gate with a hundred horsemen and told Crane-Control commander Murong Qian, "If you have horses, come with me.

sentences.zh: 」及駕出，即闔門不行。

translations.literal: When the carriage went out, they immediately shut the gate and would not go.
translations.idiomatic: When the carriage left, the gate was shut and they would not follow.

sentences.zh: 遷乃帝素親信者也，臨危如是，人皆惡之。

translations.literal: Qian was one the Emperor had long trusted; at crisis thus—people all detested him.
translations.idiomatic: Murong Qian, once trusted, failed him at the crisis—and was despised.

sentences.zh: 是月二十九日夜，帝至衛州東七八里，遇騎從自東來不避，左右叱之，乃曰：「鎮州節度使石敬瑭也。

translations.literal: On the twenty-ninth night of that month the Emperor reached seven or eight li east of Weizhou and met horsemen coming from the east who did not give way; the attendants shouted at them; they then said: "Zhenzhou military commissioner Shi Jingtang.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-ninth night he reached east of Weizhou and met horsemen from the east who would not yield; they proved to be Shi Jingtang of Zhen.

sentences.zh: 」帝喜，敬瑭拜舞於路，帝下馬慟哭，諭以「潞王危社稷，康義誠以下叛我，無以自庇，長公主見教，逆爾於路，謀社稷大計。

translations.literal: The Emperor was pleased; Jingtang bowed and danced in the road; the Emperor dismounted and wept bitterly, instructing him that "the Prince of Lu endangers the state altar; Kang Yicheng and those below have rebelled against me; I have no means to shelter myself; the Grand Princess instructs me—she meets you on the road to plot the great plan of the state altar.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor rejoiced; Jingtang bowed in the road; the emperor dismounted weeping and said Prince of Lu threatened the realm, Kang Yicheng had rebelled, he had no refuge, and the Grand Princess had sent Jingtang to help restore order.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭曰：「衛州王宏贄宿舊諳事，且就宏贄圖之。

translations.literal: Jingtang said: "Weizhou Wang Hongzan is an old hand who knows affairs—let us first consult Hongzan to plan.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang said Weizhou's Wang Hongzan knew the business and they should consult him.

sentences.zh: 」敬瑭即馳騎而前，見宏贄曰：「主上播遷，至此危迫，吾戚屬也，何以圖全？

translations.literal: Jingtang immediately galloped ahead, saw Hongzan and said: "The sovereign is driven from his throne, reaching this peril— I am his kin; how may we preserve wholeness?
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang rode ahead and asked Hongzan, "The sovereign is in peril; as his kin, how can we save him?

sentences.zh: 」宏贄曰：「天子避狄，古亦有之，然於奔迫之中，亦有將相、國寶、法物，所以軍長瞻奉，不覺其亡也。

translations.literal: Hongzan said: "The Son of Heaven flees barbarians—this too exists in antiquity; yet in urgent flight there are also generals and ministers, national treasures, and ritual objects, so army chiefs look up and do not feel he has perished.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzan said emperors had fled before, but they took ministers, regalia, and treasures so armies still revered them.

sentences.zh: 今宰職近臣從乎？

translations.literal: Do close ministers follow now?
translations.idiomatic: Are close ministers with him?

sentences.zh: 寶玉、法物從乎？

translations.literal: Do jewels and ritual objects follow now?
translations.idiomatic: Are regalia with him?

sentences.zh: 」詢之無有。

translations.literal: Inquiry found none.
translations.idiomatic: There were none.

sentences.zh: 宏贄曰：「大樹將顛，非一繩所維。

translations.literal: Hongzan said: "A great tree about to topple is not held by one rope.
translations.idiomatic: Hongzan said, "A great tree about to fall is not held by one rope.

sentences.zh: 今以五十騎奔竄，無將相一人擁從，安能興復大計！

translations.literal: Now with fifty horsemen in flight, not one general or minister escorting—how can a great restoration be raised!
translations.idiomatic: Fifty horsemen without a single minister—how can he restore the throne!

sentences.zh: 所謂蛟龍失雲雨者也。

translations.literal: This is what is called a dragon losing cloud and rain.
translations.idiomatic: This is a dragon without cloud and rain.

sentences.zh: 今六軍將士總在潞邸矣，公縱以戚藩念舊，無奈之何！

translations.literal: Now the Six Armies' generals and soldiers are all at the Prince of Lu's residence; even if you by kin and frontier old ties think of the past, nothing can be done!
translations.idiomatic: All the armies are with Prince of Lu; even as kin you can do nothing!

sentences.zh: 」遂與宏贄同謁於驛亭，宣坐謀之。

translations.literal: He then with Hongzan together called at the relay station and announced a seat to plan.
translations.idiomatic: He and Hongzan met the emperor at the relay station to plan.

sentences.zh: 敬瑭以宏贄所陳以聞，弓箭庫使沙守榮、奔洪進前謂敬瑭曰：「主上即明宗愛子，公即明宗愛婿，富貴既同受，休戚合共之。

translations.literal: Jingtang reported Hongzan's statements; Bow and Crossbow Store commissioner Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin stepped forward and told Jingtang: "The sovereign is Mingzong's beloved son; you are Mingzong's beloved son-in-law—wealth and honor you both received; joy and sorrow should be shared.
translations.idiomatic: Jingtang relayed Hongzan's words; Sha Shourong and Ben Hongjin told Jingtang, "The emperor is Mingzong's beloved son and you his son-in-law—you share his fortune and must share this crisis.

sentences.zh: 今謀於戚藩，欲期安復，翻索從臣、國寶，欲以此為辭，為賊算天子耶！

translations.literal: Now you plot with a frontier prince expecting peace and restoration, yet turn to demand followers and national treasures—do you wish to use this as a pretext and calculate the Son of Heaven for the rebel?
translations.idiomatic: You plot with a prince for safety yet demand ministers and treasures as pretexts—are you selling the emperor to the rebel?

sentences.zh: 」乃抽佩刀刺敬瑭，敬瑭親將陳暉捍之，守榮與暉單戰而死，洪進亦自刎。

translations.literal: They then drew belt knives and stabbed Jingtang; Jingtang's personal general Chen Hui defended him; Shourong and Hui fought alone and died; Hongjin also cut his own throat.
translations.idiomatic: They drew knives and stabbed Jingtang; Chen Hui defended him; Shourong died fighting Hui; Hongjin killed himself.

sentences.zh: 是日，敬瑭盡誅帝之從騎五十餘輩，獨留帝於驛，乃馳騎趨洛。

translations.literal: That day Jingtang executed the Emperor's escort of more than fifty, leaving only the Emperor at the station, then galloped toward Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: That day Jingtang killed the emperor's fifty-odd escorts, left the emperor at the station, and galloped to Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：閔帝爰自衝年，素有令問，及征從代邸，入踐堯階，屬軒皇之弓劍初遺，吳王之几杖未賜，遽生猜間，遂至奔亡。

translations.literal: The historiographer says: Emperor Min from his tender years had a fine reputation; when summoned from the Dai post to tread the Yao steps, just as the August Sovereign's bow and sword were first bequeathed and the King of Wu's armrest and staff not yet granted, suddenly suspicion arose and he came to flight and ruin.
translations.idiomatic: The historian writes: Emperor Min had a good name from youth; summoned from Yedu to rule, he inherited before the realm was settled; suspicion arose at once and he fled to ruin.

sentences.zh: 蓋輔臣無安國之謀，非少主有不君之咎。

translations.literal: It was that assisting ministers lacked plans to stabilize the state, not that a young sovereign had the fault of unprincely conduct.
translations.idiomatic: His ministers lacked plans to stabilize the state; the young emperor was not mainly to blame.

sentences.zh: 以至越在草莽，失守宗祧，斯蓋天命之難忱，土德之將謝故也。

translations.literal: Thus he ended in the wild grass, lost hold of the ancestral temple—this is surely heaven's mandate hard to rely on, the earthly virtue about to decline.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the wilds and lost the ancestral temple—heaven's mandate was failing and the dynasty's virtue was spent.
